test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence.

From start to finish, the treatment of the defendants was a (travesty) of legal due process.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The bracketed word **"travesty"** refers to a false, absurd, or distorted representation of something.(विडंबना, तिरस्कारपूर्ण अनुकरण).
 
• The correct synonym **"mockery"** means a ridiculous misrepresentation or imitation of something.(उपहास, मजाक).

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- **'Mockery'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1:** "Magic" **refers to the power of apparently influencing events by using mysterious or supernatural forces.(जादू, इंद्रजाल).
 
• Option 3**: "Tribute"** means an act, statement, or gift that is intended to show gratitude, respect, or admiration.(श्रद्धांजलि, सम्मान).
 
• Option 4: **"Slurry"** is a semi-liquid mixture, typically of fine particles suspended in water.(गाड़ा द्रव्य, घोल).

41:T9e8,
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'**
